facts.detail: The BDUK performance-information collection was first published on 24 July 2025.
The collection was last updated on 11 June 2026.
BDUK reports delivery progress through official statistics and annual report and accounts material.
BDUK began reporting delivery performance as official statistics in 2025.
Quarterly official statistics contain a subset of the full annual tables.
The April 2025 to March 2026 annual performance release is listed as official statistics dated 11 June 2026.
The October to December 2025 quarterly release is listed as official statistics dated 19 February 2026.
BDUK reports monthly on premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts.
Contract reports and official statistics measure different delivery concepts and are not directly comparable.
The Project Gigabit contract-report collection is listed as transparency data updated 20 July 2026.

facts.detail: The annual BDUK delivery-performance bulletin was published on 11 June 2026.
BDUK estimates 192,570 premises received gigabit-capable coverage through subsidy in 2025/26.
Annual delivery increased by 42,280 premises, or 28%, compared with the previous financial year.
Cumulative delivery since BDUK gigabit programmes began is estimated at 1,418,410 premises.
GIS contracts accounted for 139,490 premises, or 72% of 2025/26 delivery.
Voucher schemes accounted for 30,530 premises, or 16% of annual delivery.
Superfast and Hubs interventions together accounted for 22,550 premises, or 12%.
Rural premises represented 173,190 deliveries, or 90% of the annual total.
The bulletin reports 173,270 residential and 17,790 commercial premises delivered in 2025/26.
England accounted for 145,110 premises, or 75% of 2025/26 delivery.
